initialRun.failure: Portable wrapper did not exit normally
initialRun.passedScope: Unicode path and arguments; exact extracted package files; real PowerShell PTY output and exit code 7

firstRerun.diagnosticLimitation: The NSIS wrapper did not forward the shutdown observers' stderr; lifecycle assertions passed but the event list was empty.

fileDiagnosticAttempt.observation: Three checks passed; the close request remained pending, no shutdown file appeared, main process 91380 had an Error window and the inspector did not reply. Only fixture-owned Nook processes were force-cleaned, after confirming the error state; harness terminated with exit code 1.
fileDiagnosticAttempt.limitation: The native error text was not accessible. This instrumented run does not establish a product failure root cause.

boundedDiagnosticRun.scope: Same packaged candidate, full portable lifecycle with the original deadline covering close IPC and wrapper exit. No product change; the initial intermittent failure was not reproduced.

diagnosticChange: Await inspector disconnect; capture the filesystem function before installing delayed event callbacks; retain bounded scratch-file shutdown observations and owned-process diagnostics. Apply the original 10000 ms deadline to both the close request and wrapper exit, rather than starting after IPC acknowledgement. No product code or increased shutdown deadline.
boundary: Extraction audit alone does not prove normal portable lifecycle. A later successful rerun cannot establish that the original intermittent failure is fixed.
